standard.note: Mont. Code Ann. 39-3-409 annual CPI adjustment.

tipped.note: This state allows NO tip credit: the full state minimum wage must be paid in cash before any tips. Montana allows no tip credit at either of its two rates.

variants.label: Business not covered by the FLSA with gross annual sales of $110,000 or less
variants.test: Mont. Code Ann. 39-3-409(2). Applies ONLY where the FLSA does not reach the employer at all -- an FLSA-covered employer of any size owes at least $7.25, and in practice the state rate.
variants.note: One of only two sub-$7.25 figures in this database that is a live state rule rather than a preempted relic (the other is Oklahoma's $2.00).
